top.line: Where to sell the printed book from early December and the appliances from 1 January, with fees and rules.

in-short.line: The book in print, the appliances after Kickstarter, IngramSpark for pre-orders, our own shop first, the law.

dates.line: A 1 to 31 December Kickstarter is within the rules; payout 14 days after; general sale from 1 January.

book.line: Leanpub sells ebooks; KDP has no print pre-orders; IngramSpark does and reaches UK shops; ISBNs from £93.

campaign.line: Nowhere but Kickstarter during the campaign; present the setup as the work; a real prototype.

after.line: Our own shop, late pledges, eBay, Amazon, OnBuy; not Etsy or Not On The High Street.

law.line: Selling under our own name makes us the manufacturer: CE or UKCA, WEEE, and the Raspberry Pi trademark rules.

eu.line: Import VAT and duty over €150, and an EU responsible person under the GPSR, for later.

limits.line: Pages as read on 19 November; not legal advice; nothing listed.

sources.line: Each platform's own pages, and the launch and Pi pieces.
